name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained cluster or novel pathogen under international investigation found by 25 Nov
state: UKHSA's outbreak report for the week to 15 Nov, added on 19 Nov, covers only known pathogens: Bundibugyo Ebola and two MERS-CoV cases in Qatar linked to camel exposure, with all 99 contacts testing negative; it lists no novel or unexplained cluster (UKHSA). Searches from 22 to 25 Nov found no unexplained cluster under international investigation, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No action is needed. UKHSA and WHO publish updates if an unexplained cluster comes under investigation.
rubric_hit: Normal: no unexplained clusters under international investigation
